parsed.summary: Router r1 is configured with two Ethernet interfaces, eth1 and eth2. Eth1 serves as a gateway for the client segment (10.0.1.0/24) while eth2 connects to another router (r2) via a point-to-point link (10.0.12.0/30). r1 enables IP forwarding and has static routes configured to reach remote segments (10.0.2.0/24 and 10.0.99.0/24) through r2.

static_routes.purpose: Reach the far-side segment via r2
Reach another remote segment via r2

access_rules.purpose: Block traffic from client segment to remote segment
